Raj: Quick thought -- taco lunch + 15-min speed Pictionary after eating? low-setup.
Sophie: YES please tacos :taco: 
Tara: I'm in. indoor or courtyard? weather looks iffy.
Ben: Courtyard if sunny, otherwise kitchen table works.
Olivia: I can bring markers and a whiteboard pad. Also happy to run the Pictionary rounds.
Raj: Awesome. Plan idea: 12:15 eat, 12:40 two 7-min Pictionary rounds, winners get tiny prize (snacks).
Sophie: Prize = extra guac pls :drooling_face:
Tara: Diet notes: I'm dairy-free, can everyone mark if they need GF/vegan?
Ben: I'll bring a vegetarian taco option and gluten-free shells.
Olivia: I'll add a little poll in the thread: react :thumbsup: to attend, :tada: to bring food, :art: to help run games.
Raj: Poll up.
EventsBot: Created tentative event and poll: https://calendar.example.com/event/ef45ac73
Sophie: Reacted. I'll bring salsa and chips.
Tara: Attending + can help set up chairs.
Ben: Bringing tacos (chicken) and gf shells.
Olivia: I'll run the Pictionary prompts; any guilty-pleasure prompt suggestions?
Raj: Movie titles, weird office items, and nonsense animals.
Sophie: Add 'mystery snack' as a wildcard prompt.
Tara: Logistics: need two folding tables and 8 chairs. Ops okay to borrow?
Ben: Pinged Ops, they said yes, drop-off at 12:00.
EventsBot: Reminder scheduled for Monday 9:00 to confirm food volunteers.
Raj: Perfect. Keeping it short so people can head back to meetings. Thanks y'all :taco: :white_circle-on-black:
